sql:
SELECT
  home_store
  , COUNT(DISTINCT __buyer_count) AS buyer_count
FROM (
  SELECT
    home_store_id AS home_store
    , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN member_id END AS __buyer_count
  FROM "data"."main"."order_facts" order_facts_src_10000
  WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
) subq_5
GROUP BY
  home_store
